opening.argument: The video presents Forsage as a way to earn Ethereum by making an initial payment and purchasing progressively more valuable slots. Registration opens the X3 and X4 programs, where each subsequent slot costs twice as much and is said to generate twice the income, while each slot allegedly produces income without expiration. The payment structure directs money to participant wallets and, when a slot reopens, to an upline; the X4 arrangement likewise places participants beneath an upper team member. These mechanics are paired with claims that viewers can earn Ethereum daily and even without referring anyone, alongside the possibility of unusually large returns. The position rests on these promotional claims and payment mechanics, not independently verified earnings, technical operation, or completed transactions.

citations.quote: In the next 5 minutes, I'll show you how you can earn Ethereum Daily, paid directly and instantly to your own Ethereum Wallet
Each subsequent slot you purchase is 2 times the value of the previous one. and it generates twice the income as well.
Each slot generates you income unlimited times with no expiration.
Spot 3 re-opens that slot again and payment goes to your upline.
